notes: Scanner tab renamed to Tools, RAW scan disclosure banner, thumbnail path fixes
changelog: Added: option to mark a report as a RAW scan result — shows an editable warning banner in the generated report explaining that files were found directly on the disk (structure could not be read), may be damaged/incomplete, and original names/folders might not be recoverable. Comes with a ready-to-use default text, already translated into all 14 report languages, which can be overridden with your own

Renamed: the 'Scanner' tab is now called 'Tools' (in all 14 app languages) — it has grown well beyond just scanning (signature verification, thumbnails, extension/name recovery, copy merging, and more)

Fixed: with 'Show OK/Damaged statistics' turned off, the Status column now disappears entirely from the report table (header and all rows), and row colors turn neutral instead of green/red/orange — previously only the top summary numbers respected this setting

Fixed: JPG/JPEG/JPE signature database was missing the Adobe APP14 marker (FF D8 FF EE) — fully valid photos from Photoshop/Lightroom were being flagged as bad-signature and moved to the damaged-files folder

Fixed: photos exported from certain Motion-JPEG/AVI sources have a couple of stray bytes before the real JPEG start — the structure validator now tolerates a small offset instead of rejecting the file outright

Fixed: a TXT bad-file report and CSV file list exported from PC-3000 in different contexts (e.g. one from the drive root, one from a specific user folder) could use different path prefixes and fail to match — paths are now normalized so both link up correctly, including files that only exist in the TXT report
Fixed: the folder/file picker dialogs no longer 'remember' each other's last location — each field now starts from its own current value

Fixed: thumbnails generated from the Scanner tab were being written to a temporary location in the source folder even when a base output folder was already configured, instead of going straight to the destination

Fixed: files with a successfully generated but visually corrupted thumbnail (solid color, mostly black, or a damaged band partway through the image) are now flagged for review in the report and the thumbnail is still shown, instead of being silently hidden
Fixed: the Generator tab's file preview now supports folder-by-folder navigation with a breadcrumb trail, matching how the final report behaves, instead of showing a flat list of every file at once
